messages:
lee: Quick follow-up from the routing-RFC: two near-misses where cost-preference selected a cheaper variant that later had p99 blasts. Need a minimal safety contract for policy.
maya: TL;DR: runtime emitted only cost and model-compat; policy picked cheapest, latency spiked, frontend timed out.
sam: Traces show no health hint from that runtime. Policy assumed healthy.
eli: Proposal: mandate three lightweight canonical fields on route descriptors: runtime.capacity_score (0-1), runtime.probe_p99_ms, runtime.signal_ts. Missing -> conservative defaults.
jordan: Add staleness aging: if signal_ts older than 12s, decay capacity_score toward 0.2. Prevents stale probes hiding hot GPUs.
rachel: UX: Console should surface normalized signal + raw metric and offer a simulation preview per-route/time-window.
lee: Policy sketch: if same-region && capacity_score>=0.6 && probe_p99_ms<=300 => prefer primary; else if capacity_score>=0.4 && cost_delta<=0.15 => allow cost pick; else hedge(N=1) preferring latency up to cost_cap=0.25.
maya: Implementation: ship a compiler adapter that normalizes per-runtime payloads to canonical fields so runtimes don't need immediate changes. Adapter includes per-runtime mappers/versioned heuristics.
sam: Backcompat: runtimes w/o fields -> capacity_score=0.33, probe_p99_ms=9999, signal_ts=now-60s (forces conservative). Document in SDK.
eli: Ops: I'll run a 30d sim against traces once we have mapping table to estimate egress and performance impact. Must include probe-staleness and fast-cost-change scenarios.
jordan: Alerts to add: region.capacity_score_drop (30% drop, 1m) and routing.hedge_rate_spike.
ops-bot: @jordan created alert: "region.capacity_score_drop" threshold=30% window=60s. Runbook linked.
rachel: Tradeoff: hedging will raise cross-region egress. Make hedging opt-in per-tenant initially and surface egress estimate in Console. Optimize team to provide per-tenant sim.
lee: Action items:
- eli: mapping doc + adapter heuristics (ETA Wed)
- sam: unit tests + sim harness PR (ETA Thu)
- maya: RFC follow-up + rollout notes (ETA Tue)
- rachel: console preview mock + opt-in copy (ETA Mon)
- jordan: create alerts (done)
lee: If no objections I'll open the decision record and start the rollout track with per-tenant opt-in.
maya: +1
sam: +1
eli: +1
